description: Search the tested agent skill files for sale (free). Give a plain-language query (for example: sound less like ChatGPT), or filter by category, tag or language, or combine them. With a query the results come ranked by relevance; without one you get the featured skills first. Each card has match_reason (the field that matched, or the filter), price_usd (a one-time purchase of the SKILL.md file, yours forever), what it is for, what it is not for, and how it was tested. limit is at most 24.

category.description: Only skills in this category. One of: writing, editing, marketing, seo, research, code, agents, sales-support, business, data, translation, education (see list_categories). Any other value is an error.

language.description: Only skills that work in this language: a 2-3 letter code such as en, bg or de, or 'any'. Skills marked 'any' always match.

limit.description: How many skills to return, 1 to 24. Default 24.

query.description: Plain-language search text, for example 'sound less like ChatGPT'. At most 100 characters. Omit it to get the featured skills first instead of a ranked search.

tag.description: Only skills with this tag: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, at most 32 characters, for example 'humanize'.

name: search_skills

payment.description: Payment summary shared by the skills (same as each card's payment); null when nothing matched.

skills.description: Matching skill cards, best first. Empty when nothing matched.

buy_url.description: HTTP address to buy the file (x402).

category.description: Category slug; null if the skill has no category yet.

category_url.description: Page of the category; null if there is no category.

faq.description: Questions and answers about the skill.

languages.description: Language codes the skill works in, or 'any'.

url.description: Page with the full license text.

match_reason.description: The field that matched the query (or the filter); null if there is no query or filter.

mcp_tool.description: Always null: buying is over HTTP, not MCP.

not_for.description: What the skill is not for; null if not stated.

payment.description: Short payment summary: protocol, asset, network and whether selling is open.

selling.description: Whether the shop is open for payments right now.

price_micro.description: The same price in millionths of a dollar.

price_usd.description: One-time price in US dollars, as a decimal string.

purchases_count.description: Number of purchases; null until there are at least 10.

redownload_url_template.description: HTTP address template of the free re-download; {token} is the receipt token.

related_url.description: API address of the related skills.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the file, lowercase hex.

size_bytes.description: Size of the SKILL.md file in bytes.

slug.description: Stable identifier of the skill; use it with get_skill.

tested.description: How the skill was tested; null if not recorded.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 time of the last update.

version.description: Current semantic version of the SKILL.md file.

title: Search skills
